description: Step-by-step guide (Markdown) for fixing a problem the check found, for the site's platform when one exists (otherwise the general version). With consent_tool, returns the guide for wiring the Meta, TikTok and OpenAI pixels to that consent tool instead. Guides exist for: meta.fires_before_consent, meta.not_firing_after_consent, meta.duplicate_pixel, meta.missing_event_id, meta.fbc_not_set, meta.server_copy_without_event_id, meta.server_event_id_mismatch, tiktok.fires_before_consent, tiktok.not_firing_after_consent, tiktok.event_id_reused, tiktok.duplicate_pixel, tiktok.missing_event_id, tiktok.click_id_not_set, tiktok.mobile_cta_tracking_mismatch, tiktok.multiple_pixels, tiktok.server_copy_without_event_id, tiktok.server_event_id_mismatch, openai.fires_before_consent, openai.not_firing_after_consent, openai.event_id_reused, openai.duplicate_pixel, openai.missing_event_id, openai.click_id_not_set, openai.mobile_cta_tracking_mismatch, openai.multiple_pixels, openai.server_copy_without_event_id, openai.server_event_id_mismatch. Setup guides (pass the id as issue_id): general.server_side_not_detected (setting up the Meta Conversions API), tiktok.events_api_setup (setting up the TikTok Events API), openai.pixel_setup (installing the OpenAI Pixel), openai.conversions_api_setup (setting up the OpenAI Conversions API).

consent_tool.description: Consent tool guide: complianz (Complianz), cookiebot (Cookiebot), cookieyes (CookieYes), onetrust (OneTrust), usercentrics (Usercentrics)

issue_id.description: Problem id from a report, e.g. meta.fires_before_consent

platform.description: Site platform from the report, e.g. framer, shopify, webflow, wordpress
